I have farmed this land in Iringa for many years, and I know this soil well. I will put both manure from my cattle and some fertilizer from the shop on this maize plot because the crops grow better when I feed the soil. My children and grandchildren will help with the planting and weeding, but I will need to hire a few young men from the village when the work is heavy. At my age, I cannot do the bending and digging like I used to, but I still oversee everything and make sure it is done right.
